name: Farali chivda
ingredients:
POTATO (45%), EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (PALMOLEIN OIL), SPLIT PEANUTS (14%), SUGAR, EDIBLE COMMON SALT (ROCK SALT), SPICES & CONDIMENTS (TURMERIC POWDER, CLOVE, CINNAMON, STAR ANISE, CORIANDER POWDER AND RED CHILLI POWDER).

ALLERGEN ADVICE:

CONTAINS PEANUTS

MAY CONTAINS CEREALS CONTAINING GLUTEN, MILK, TREE NUTS, PEANUTS, SESAME SEEDS, MUSTARD SEEDS AND SOYA.
